chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Measure your food, for indeed, the blessing is in the measured food.

key_terms.الْبَرَكَةَ: divine blessing and increase in benefit
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.كِيلُوا: measure out; use a proper measure for provisions

ai.seo_question: Why did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say to measure food?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers to measure their food and teaches that barakah is found in food that is properly measured. It reflects an ethic of order, moderation, and care in handling provisions.
